title: Multi-Winner Voting with Argumentative Ballots
abstract: arXiv:2608.23247v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce multi-winner voting with argumentative ballots (MVArg) and investigate theoretical properties. As our conceptual contribution, we generalise approval ballots to argumentative ballots, thereby allowing voters to express defeasible preferences over candidates. We accordingly generalise voter cohesion and justified representation axioms JR, PJR and EJR. As our theoretical contribution, we establish several key results. First, MVArg is strictly more expressive than multi-winner voting with approval ballots (MV). Second, our notions of cohesion and justified representation are conservative generalisations of their counterparts in MV. Third, the MVArg counterpart of JR can always be satisfied, whereas the counterparts of PJR and EJR cannot always be. Fourth, although verifying whether a winner set satisfies the MVArg counterpart of JR is already coNP-hard, such a winner set can be constructed in polynomial time. All definitions,

translated_title: 具有论证性选票的多赢家投票
translated_abstract: 我们引入了具有论证性选票的多赢家投票（MVArg）并研究了其理论性质。作为概念贡献，我们将批准选票推广为论证性选票，从而使选民能够表达对候选人的可废止偏好。相应地，我们推广了选民凝聚力和正当代表公理JR、PJR和EJR。作为理论贡献，我们建立了几个关键结果。首先，MVArg在表达能力上严格强于具有批准选票的多赢家投票（MV）。其次，我们的凝聚力和正当代表概念是MV中对应概念的保守推广。第三，MVArg中的JR对应物总能被满足，而PJR和EJR的对应物则不能总是被满足。第四，尽管验证一个赢家集是否满足MVArg中的JR对应物已经是coNP-hard问题，但这样的赢家集可以在多项式时间内构造。所有定义均包含在内。
tldr: 本文首次引入论证性选票的多赢家投票框架，证明其表达能力优于传统批准选票，并系统分析了正当代表公理的满足性与复杂性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces multi-winner voting with argumentative ballots, showing it is strictly more expressive than approval ballots, and analyzes the satisfiability and complexity of justified representation axioms.
